comment: Pins every vendored library under public/vendor/ and src/vendor/. Checked by test/security/vendor-lock.test.mjs; rehash with node scripts/vendor-lock.mjs after a deliberate upgrade; advisories via node scripts/vendor-advisories.mjs.

libraries.name: mermaid
libraries.build: npm pack mermaid@11.17.2 (dist/mermaid.core.mjs, externals left to node_modules), installed fresh on 2026-10-22 with dompurify@3.4.17 pinned beside it (GHSA-c6gr-qvv4-5v3f, GHSA-cg2g-xh64-v4q7, GHSA-mrv2-3pqr-j5jr name 3.4.17 as the first fixed release), then bundled with esbuild 0.25.0: --bundle --minify --keep-names --platform=browser --format=iife --global-name=__esbuild_esm_mermaid_nm.mermaid --banner:js='"use strict";' --footer:js='globalThis["mermaid"] = globalThis.__esbuild_esm_mermaid_nm["mermaid"].default;'. The published dist/mermaid.min.js of every mermaid release through 12.2.0 still bundles an older DOMPurify.

libraries.name: dompurify
libraries.versionSource: .version="3.4.17" and the DOMPurify 3.4.17 banner inside mermaid.min.js

libraries.name: vditor
libraries.note: includes the Lute markdown engine (GopherJS, go1.21.13) as dist/js/lute/lute.min.js; Lute is not an npm package

libraries.name: katex
libraries.note: shipped inside Vditor; includes the mhchem extension

libraries.name: lucide
libraries.versionSource: none: the icon shapes come from a lucide-icons/lucide checkout named only in scripts/build-lucide-moving.mjs, and no file records its version, so the OSV lookup skips it

libraries.name: decklet
libraries.note: grunion-ai/decklet, pinned by commit; not an npm package

libraries.name: lobehub-icons
libraries.build: Copied as shipped: claude-color, claudecode-color, openai, codex-color, gemini-color, geminicli-color and antigravity-color. Brand marks of Anthropic, OpenAI and Google, used to name each agent on the connect step.

libraries.name: crepe
libraries.note: Milkdown Crepe editor and its dependency tree (ProseMirror, remark, CodeMirror 6, KaTeX, Vue), all MIT, ISC, BSD or MPL-2.0 OR Apache-2.0; the package list with licenses is THIRD-PARTY.txt
libraries.build: npm i @milkdown/crepe@7.23.0 esbuild@0.25.0, then esbuild an entry re-exporting Crepe, remarkStringifyOptionsCtx, editorViewCtx, parserCtx, serializerCtx and remarkCtx from @milkdown/kit/core, replaceAll, getMarkdown, insert and $prose from @milkdown/kit/utils, Plugin, PluginKey and TextSelection from @milkdown/kit/prose/state, Decoration and DecorationSet from @milkdown/kit/prose/view, listener and listenerCtx from @milkdown/kit/plugin/listener: --bundle --minify --format=esm --splitting --chunk-names=chunk-[hash] --entry-names=crepe; crepe.css bundles @milkdown/crepe/theme/common/style.css and theme/frame.css with --loader:.woff=file --loader:.woff2=file --loader:.ttf=file --loader:.svg=dataurl --asset-names=font-[hash]
